what: Vertically stacked cards (23em, 5em gap) each stick at clamp(10em, 26vh, 14em) from the top of the screen, and later cards cover earlier ones. While a card’s head rises from 75% of the screen to its sticking position, it is tied to scroll and moves to its own fan position (tilt −6·−2·3·7°, x −16·−5.25·5.25·16em, y 2.5·0·3.25·5.5em, power1.in), and once all are stuck the four spread out like a fan. At the moment of sticking they spread sideways by 1.5 times the font size, are pressed by .33 of that (.1s power1.out), then bounce back with a 1s elastic.out(1, .3). The fan narrows with viewport width (tablet −4·−1.5·2·5°/±6·2em, phone −3·−1·2·4°/±1.5·.5em)

options.rotate · rotate-mid · rotate-narrow: Tilt per card (degrees, comma-separated, repeating), default 0,4,-4 — mid is 768~991px, narrow is 767px and below
options.x · x-mid · x-narrow: Horizontal offset per card (including units such as em), default 0em
options.start: Position where the handoff to the fan begins, default top 75%
options.squash: Press scale (multiple of font size), default 1.5
options.[data-fx-part=face]: Animated card face — the slot itself if none
options.--fx-top · --fx-w · --fx-gap: Sticky height, card width, gap (CSS variables)
